type.primary: research from the lab -> "From the Lab"
type.preprint: a preprint from the lab, not yet in a journal -> "From the Lab", "Preprints" subsection
type.note: reviews and commentary from the lab -> "From the Lab", "Notes and Reviews" subsection
type.previous: first-author work predating the lab -> "Previous Work"

_memo.why by hand: type cannot be derived from the author list, because co-corresponding authorship is not visible there.
_memo.required: title, authors, journal, year, type. volume, pages, doi and pmid are optional; the title links to the DOI when present, otherwise to PubMed.
_memo.preprints: use the server as the journal (bioRxiv, medRxiv) and its DOI.
_memo.build: python3 tools/build_publications.py  — writes publications.html and keeps the count in the page hero honest.
